firm_data.firm_description: Meliora Law is a women-owned boutique firm located in New York’s Capital District. Our attorneys are experienced in corporate law, transactions, tax, health care, trusts and estates, and not-for-profit law, and are committed to providing exceptional legal services to clients through practical and innovative solutions.
